final: SELECT s1.sex, s1.avg_acl_igg, s1.avg_ana, s1.avg_ana / s2.overall_avg_ana as ratio FROM (SELECT p.SEX as sex, AVG(e."aCL IgG") as avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) as avg_ana FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX) s1, (SELECT AVG(subq.avg_ana) as overall_avg_ana FROM (SELECT AVG(e.ANA) as avg_ana FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX) subq) s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg_ana IS NOT NULL
